assets.note: Synthetic composition stand-in, not accepted production art.

presentation.continuity: One prop identity with a stable position and exactly one owner before/after handover.
presentation.grounding_occlusion: Feet contact the floor; table front occludes legs while the actor is behind it.

movement.depth_policy: Cut from a correctly sized near pose to a smaller far-door pose; do not slide an unchanged sprite into depth.

presentation.rationale: People inhabit a fixed perspective room and must fit its depth.

ui.dialogue_and_choices: Advance readable dialogue explicitly; choices represent decisions, not a flow-debug button list.
ui.essential_visibility: Keep the relevant speaker, prop and doorway cue visible with the overlay; hidden samplers do not grant knowledge.
ui.portraits: Optional foreground portrait is UI, not a giant world actor.

presentation.world_scale: Use feet on the floor plane and the far doorway as depth anchors; farther actors are smaller.

art.use: Provisional neutral palette and character identity.

composition.use: Provisional camera and interaction staging, separate from flow.

flow.use: Dialogue and exit semantics only; not a layout reference.

scope: Synthetic brief only; no runtime or accepted visual evidence.
